threshold_basis: MASTER-PLAN Phase 0: 'Set the gate threshold N=5 seams (agreed number, adjustable at review)'
counting_rule: one record per (module × coupling kind) — the natural key of the coupling-inventory.json schema ({module, kind, ...}); seam_count = number of inventory records. spike/seam-harness.test.mjs re-derives the same (module × kind) set from live measurement on every `node --test` run and fails the suite on any drift, so this count can never silently rot.
verdict_statement: Wave 1 first deliverable = refactor-in-place with suite kept green
counting_sensitivity: Recorded for honesty: the 13 per-module records collapse to 5 distinct coupling MECHANISMS (see seams_by_mechanism). Under that maximally-merged counting the count would be 5 = N, which would read 'proceed as extension'. The schema-defined per-record counting (13) is normative for this verdict. The divergence is immaterial to what gets built: both readings land on the same first work item, because the frozen plan's engine-core wave already carries the refactor-in-place deliverables (see plan_impact) — so no counting debate changes the build order, and the review retains its 'adjustable at review' authority over N.
import_time_finding: All six stage modules import cleanly outside a Foundry git repo (measured): zero import-time git commands, zero import-time marker checks, zero import-time writes. The gate question 'importable and runnable outside a Foundry git repo' therefore splits: IMPORTABLE — yes, everywhere; RUNNABLE — no, five runtime mechanisms block or corrupt ordinary-folder runs.
plan_impact: No plan amendment required. The frozen IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN 'Wave 1 — Engine Core' wave already lists as leading deliverables: stage functions with signature stage(ctx), 'module-level shared state from the Wave-0 inventory eliminated', and 'tidy-idy suite green after each stage's conversion' — exactly the >N branch's required scope. This verdict makes that scoping FORMAL: engine-core work begins with the refactor-in-place of the 13 recorded seams, keeping the legacy suite green throughout, before any new-behavior stage lands.
